label: Hand-drawn
summary: Wobbly ink lines with a pencil pass over light watercolour
history: Sketchbook and journal illustration: ink pen over loose watercolour.
look: Wobbly ink lines with a second, looser pencil pass over light watercolour fills on off-white paper.

line.quality: Strong wobble (0.55) plus a second sketchy pencil line

fill: Light watercolour, desaturated and lifted towards white
shading: None — the wash itself is uneven

characters.costume: Loosely washed colour, often not filling the lines

environment.sky: Bare paper with a faint blue wash

border: Hand-inked rectangle that does not quite close

composition.focalPoint: One sketched subject with notes around it
composition.framing: Vignetted — art fades to paper at the edges

dos: Let colour spill past the lines

generation.description: Organic illustrations that look manually drawn using pencils, pens and traditional sketching techniques.
generation.visualIdentity: Personal, artistic and expressive sketchbook illustration.
generation.linework: Visible pencil strokes, imperfect contours, sketch marks and varied line weights.
generation.textures: Paper grain, graphite, colored pencil strokes, cross-hatching and light watercolor.
generation.characters: Natural hand-drawn proportions, expressive faces and imperfect organic shapes.
generation.backgrounds: Sketchy landscapes, trees, houses, countryside and hand-rendered environmental details.
generation.lighting: Natural soft lighting with hand-shaded shadows.
generation.composition: Loose organic compositions with visible drawing details and sketchbook aesthetics.
generation.instructions: Create an illustration that appears genuinely hand-drawn using pencils and colored pencils. Preserve visible strokes, paper texture and slightly imperfect contours.
generation.promptModifier: Render as an authentic hand-drawn illustration with organic pencil strokes, visible sketch lines, imperfect contours, colored pencil shading, subtle graphite marks, natural paper texture and expressive hand-rendered details. Preserve an artistic handmade appearance.
generation.negativePrompt: Perfect vector geometry, glossy 3D rendering, photorealism, overly smooth surfaces, plastic textures.
generation.negativeModifier: Perfect vector edges, glossy 3D rendering, photorealistic surfaces, overly smooth digital appearance.
